text: Understanding databases is an important skill for anyone working with data. Most databases fall into two main types: SQL and NoSQL. SQL databases store information in tables, which are organised into rows and columns. To get data from them, you write queries using a language like SQL. NoSQL databases are more flexible and store data differently, which is useful for certain projects. Data modelling is the process of planning how your data is structured before you build anything. Finally, indexes help the database find information quickly, especially when there is a lot of data. Learning these basics makes it much easier to work with databases.
